name: Zeke
description: 100 random maps! Walk to the edge to warp. Each map has unique colors, enemy types (Slimes, Dragons, Ghosts...), and difficulty. No timer - survive as long as you can!

name: Zeke
description: Purple swirling portals! Each map has one in a random spot. Walk into it to warp to a new map. Monsters ignore it - only you can use it!

name: Ben
description: Outer space! The arena is now deep space with 200 twinkling stars, bright cross-shaped stars, and colorful nebula clouds that change with each map!

name: Ken
description: Enemy ships! Every monster sails in on a little wooden boat with a colored sail, a mast with a red flag, and water ripples. They bob and tilt on the waves!
